method: Closed loop. Process restart, not OS cache eviction. First LIST has no warmup; startup excluded. Mixed cycles: one overwrite then flat and grouped LIST; separate immutable key per cycle, stable key set. Separate create/delete cycles use private prefixes and verify acknowledged presence/absence. Subrequest intervals record actual PUT/LIST overlap. Large payloads SHAKE256 per key, generation excluded, streaming SHA256 GET validation included. RSS=sum(server processes), sampled ~200ms; excludes client/OS cache. TLS/audit off; SDK retries off. Client and all servers share one host/disk. No performance gate.
